versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the augmentation system is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.2.8.2 Augmentation systems. b. 5.2.8.2.1 Rate of control surface displacement. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation. Additional Reference: 14 CFR 27; 27 Appendix B VII Stability Augmentation System (SAS)

Standard: Operation of stability augmentation and CASs and devices, including in the presence of saturation or rate limiting, do not result in flying qualities worse than Level 2 in up to uncommon atmospheric disturbances. Control rates are able to retain stabilization and control in extraordinary atmospheric disturbances. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the augmentation system's robustness as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Rate of Control Surface Displacement paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the augmentation system's robustness as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Rate of Control Surface Displacement paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the augmentation system's robustness as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Rate of Control Surface Displacement paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
